decisions.reason: The multi-model aloe vera line with its own page is the firm's most visible and heavily invested launch, so management persists with it and treats any weak results as launch-phase effects.
The hyaluronic serum fits the core facial care range and costs little to sustain in small batches, so dropping it would contradict the earlier keep decision without releasing much in resources.
The cleansing milk is a staple that complements the facial range and has been reaffirmed before, so management keeps justifying it as part of a coherent assortment.
The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and extends the cleansing segment, so any disappointing results are readily attributed to its short time on the market.
